title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for missing-spend recognition
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for missing-spend recognition.

## Handling condition

For missing-spend recognition: The official export evidence must exist before recording it. Copied provider-export physical quantities in support service records are reconciliation evidence, not accounting postings. No support commitment or portfolio discount applies to this on-demand reconciliation scope. For the single aggregated missing-spend meter, copy support event reference exactly from the selected latest billing review's related evidence reference, and store that same reference as the new meter's related evidence reference. This review-designated export is the sole evidence locator for the aggregate; every qualifying export fragment still contributes its quantity, but no other fragment's identifier may substitute as the locator.
